$comment: The night-lights square over the US East Coast at the hero video's instant, when the Sun sets at UMN: New York, Philadelphia, Baltimore and Washington already lit, the sunset glow on the Earth's edge beyond. The observer is on the great circle from New York away from the Sun, in the Earth's shadow, so the meter exposes for the night. A candidate for the night-lighting card, not published: the moonlit ground (the Moon is nearly full) or the distance leaves its lights less striking than south-east Brazil's.
name: night-lights-orbit-us-east
description: From 400 km over the Atlantic at 23:10:58 UTC on 25 October 2026 (19:10:58 EDT, the hero video's instant), looking west-north-west to the lit coast of New York and New England, about 1,100 km away, and the sunset glow on the Earth's edge.
